tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild anemia with low hemoglobin, hematocrit, and erythrocyte count, while red cell indices (MCV, MCH, MCHC) are within normal limits, suggesting normocytic, normochromic anemia. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is elevated, indicating increased variability in platelet size, possibly reflecting reactive changes. Further evaluation of anemia etiology is recommended.
